svg.title: Risk reduction allocation of WP-C-05
svg.desc: One row per rated row of the risk assessment, grouped by hazard: the adopted Performance Level, then the measures of each of the three steps of ISO 12100 as chips coloured by kind, and the residual-risk class as a marker on the right.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 5-1 Risk reduction allocated to the three steps of ISO 12100 §6: 25 rated rows, 15 hazards

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left to right is the order of the method; the marker on the right is the residual-risk class of WP-C-05 §1.1. 5 rows are open (CFG-002 or no design yet), one is excluded
